NOTICE UNDER REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980 AS AMENDED BY THEREGISTRATION OF ELECTORS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 10 OF 2017
WHEREAS certain persons have been internally displaced as a result of any actions of terrorist militant or other groupduring the recent past ;
02. Whereas in terms of Section 2 of the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 10 of 2017, anycitizen of Sri Lanka :
2.1 who is or had been an internally displaced person ;
2.2 whose name appeared in the register of electors for any electoral district for any year, until the end of theyear 2009 ; and
2.3 whose name has not been entered in any register in operation subsequent to the year 2009,

shall on proof of the above matters and on production of a certificate issued by the Grama Niladhari of the areain which he is presently residing to the effect that he is or had been an internally displaced person, be entitled to make anapplication to the registering officer of the electoral district within which he was premanently resident prior to May 18,2009, to be registered in the register of electors of such electoral district ;
03. And whereas in terms of Section 2(3) of the aforesaid Special Provisions Act, the children of a citizen of SriLanka referred to in paragraph 2 above :

3.1 who had not attained the age of eighteen years on the date on which such citizen became an internallydisplaced person and have attained the age of eighteen years or more on the date on which the revisioncommenced in respect of the register in operation, at the time in which the application is made ;

3.2 who are born after such citizen became an internally displaced person and have attained the age of eighteenyears or more on the date on which the revision commenced in respect of the register in operation, at thetime in which the application is made ; and
3.3 whose name has not been entered in any register in operation subsequent to the year 2009,

shall on production of the birth certificate of such child sought to be registered and a certificate issued by theGrama Niladhari of the area in which he is presently residing on proof of the above matters, be entitled to make anapplication to the registering officer of the electoral district within which he/his parents was/were premanetly residentprior to May 18, 2009, to be registered in the register of electors of such electoral district ;

04. In terms of the powers vested to the Election Commission under the Registration of Electors (SpecialProvisions) ; Act, No. 10 of 2017, Election Commission do hereby notify that the receipt of applications for the preparationof a supplementary register of electors for the year 2018 including the names of those who meet the requirementsspecified in paragraphs 02 and 03 above will commence on 26th day of October 2018 and will close on 01st day ofNovember 2018 ; that relevant applications forms could be obtained from the offices of the registering officers of allelectoral districts in Sri Lanka ; and that dully filled applications be submitted to the relevant registering officers.

05. Election Commission further notify that it is expected to finalize the preparation of the supplementaryregister referred to in paragraph 04 above on 02nd day of November 2018 and the notice thereon to be issued on that dayitself and that it is also expected to allocate additional time period of 14 days for those who fulfill the requirementsspecified above and whose names are not entered in the said supplementary register to make appeals to enter their namesin the supplementary register.
